(1) Birds have special adaptations for protecting tissues against oxidative damage and for repairing brain neurons, which may contribute to their slow aging; (2) Birds are more resistant to oxidative stress than mammals because they have higher levels of antioxidant enzymes in their tissues, higher blood glucose levels, and lower levels of ROS in their blood; and (3) Birds have a higher capacity to regenerate brain neurons than mammals, which may be due to their higher blood glucose levels.
